mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_outbound_documents(outbound_id,order_id,merchant_id,payload_fingerprint,warehouse_id) VALUES(#{outboundId},#{orderId},#{merchantId},#{fingerprint},#{warehouseId}) ON CONFLICT (outbound_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT payload_fingerprint FROM inventory_outbound_documents WHERE outbound_id=#{outboundId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.product_id AS productId,SUM(l.quantity) AS quantity FROM inventory_outbound_documents d JOIN inventory_outbound_lines l ON l.outbound_id=d.outbound_id WHERE d.order_id=#{orderId} AND d.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} GROUP BY l.product_id
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_outbound_event_outbox SET published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND published_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending, AS oldestSeconds FROM inventory_outbound_event_outbox o JOIN inventory_outbound_documents d ON d.outbound_id=o.outbound_id WHERE o.published_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_outbound_event_outbox SET next_attempt_at= WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND published_at IS NULL
